result.summary: Found 1 visual issue: a section header shows an unresolved localization key instead of translated text.

issues.description: Section header displays raw localization key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of a human-readable translated title.
issues.suggestion: Resolve the localization key to its proper translated value (e.g., 'Popular near you') and ensure translation files contain the key for all supported locales.
